name: Additional Rolls
progression_note: Adds a stacked roll; this is the guaranteed Kakeraloot reward.
description: Adds one roll to the account's $us roll stock.

name: Kakera
progression_note: Repeatable reward; exact reward weights and amounts are not modeled yet.

name: Reset Timer Cooldown
progression_note: The effective $rt cooldown improvement has a cap; further loot behavior must be modeled separately.

name: Disablelist Capacity
progression_note: Repeatable; additional capacity and roll-pool limits become rarer as they increase.
description: Improves $disable/$limroul capacity and lowers applicable roulette limits.

name: Permanent Rolls
progression_note: Repeatable; each additional permanent roll becomes rarer.
description: Adds a permanent roll per hour.

name: Wishlist Slots
progression_note: Repeatable; each additional wishlist slot becomes rarer.

name: Wishprotect
progression_note: The effective spawn chance has a cap, although additional levels can still be received.
description: Unlocks or improves the additional chance to spawn a protected wishlist character.

name: Mudapins
description: Awards Mudapins, the collection currency tracked by $mp.

name: $bku Reset Chance
progression_note: Applies when rolling an eligible Starwish; exact probability progression is not modeled yet.
description: Adds a chance to complete and reset $bku after rolling a Starwish.

name: Star Branches
description: Awards Star Branches used to unlock additional $starwish slots.
